question: ‘Mitra Mela’ was a revolutionary organisation founded by:
solution:
The correct answer is **Vinayak Savarkar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar** was a prominent freedom fighter and the founder of the Mitra Mela, which later evolved into the Abhinav Bharat Society.
 
• This organization was **established in 1899** in Nasik as a secret society of revolutionaries.
 
• The main aim of Mitra Mela was to **attain complete independence** for India through revolutionary means.
 
• Savarkar was inspired by the revolutionary movements of Italy and Ireland, and he aimed to set up a similar structure in India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Bhupendra Nath Bose
 A freedom fighter, not directly related to the founding of Mitra Mela.
 
 

 Khudiram Bose
 A young revolutionary, known for his role in Muzaffarpur bombing but not associated with the founding of Mitra Mela.
 
 

 Sisir Kumar Bose
 Related to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and played a key role in the Indian freedom struggle but was not a founder of Mitra Mela.
